paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter with spectroscopy of radio-frequency atomic transitions
notes: Paper constrains THREE distinct coupling types: (1) ScalarPhoton (d_e, coupling to fine-structure constant α), (2) ScalarElectron (d_me, coupling to electron mass), and (3) ScalarNucleon (d_g, coupling to QCD scale Λ_QCD). Additionally, pseudoscalar/QCD-axion constraints on 1/f_φ are presented. The pre-analysis hint suggested ScalarElectron, but the paper's primary results span multiple scalar couplings shown in Fig. 3a-c. Extraction confidence is low (0.45) because: (i) the paper presents constraints on THREE different scalar couplings simultaneously, making it ambiguous which is 'primary'; (ii) the data_points returned represent only a mass-range span for d_me without explicit numerical coupling values extracted from figures or tables; (iii) Fig. 3 shows exclusion curves but precise numerical values at specific masses are not tabulated. The paper states bounds improve by factors of ×100 in the 1–200 Hz range and ×3 orders of magnitude for d_e from Dy, but does not provide a single canonical (mass, coupling) table. To properly extract all three scalar couplings and the pseudoscalar limit, one would need to digitize Figs. 3 and 4, which is beyond reliable manual extraction. The DM density ρ_DM ≈ 3×10^-6 eV^4 is stated in the paper and used in the UBDM field amplitude φ_0 = m_φ^-1 √(2ρ_DM), but this is a standard galactic halo assumption, not a free parameter—it is NOT a local DM density in GeV/cm³ units (which would apply only to haloscope experiments like ADMX).
